state_invariants_metadata.scope: Frontend Behavioral State Invariants Verification Matrix

invariants.name: Backend Truth Preservation
invariants.statement: Displayed authoritative business state must correspond to backend state.
invariants.implementation: Components consume authoritative data directly from TanStack Query hooks without synthetic overrides.

invariants.name: Tenant Isolation
invariants.statement: Data cached/rendered for Tenant A must never appear under Tenant B.
invariants.implementation: switchActiveTenant(queryClient, tenantId) sets tenant storage and invokes queryClient.clear(); apiClient injects X-Tenant-ID header.

invariants.name: Object Identity
invariants.statement: Alert A, Case A, Report A must never display data belonging to another object due to stale query state.
invariants.implementation: Queries are keyed with unique object ID (['case', id]); detail view unmounts/resets state on route change.

invariants.name: Query-Key Completeness
invariants.statement: Query/cache keys must include every identity dimension required to distinguish authoritative data.
invariants.implementation: Filters, object IDs, and pagination participate in cache key composition; cache cleared on tenant change.

invariants.name: Mutation Target Integrity
invariants.statement: A mutation initiated from object A must not execute against object B after navigation or asynchronous state changes.
invariants.implementation: Mutation variables bind caseId/alertId explicitly from route parameters and loaded object identity.

invariants.name: Out-of-Order Response Safety
invariants.statement: Older asynchronous responses must not overwrite newer authoritative state.
invariants.implementation: TanStack Query automatically tracks request timestamps and query cancellation on route navigation.

invariants.name: Optimistic Update Safety
invariants.statement: Optimistic state must either be confirmed or correctly rolled back/reconciled.
invariants.implementation: Mutations execute onError handlers that invalidate cache keys to restore authoritative backend state.

invariants.name: Error Truthfulness
invariants.statement: Failed backend operations must not appear successful.
invariants.implementation: Component catch blocks capture server error responses, display exact HTTP details, and prevent success banners.

invariants.name: Status Semantic Parity
invariants.statement: Frontend labels must preserve backend business meaning.
invariants.implementation: CASE_STATUS_LABELS maps exact CaseStatus enum values without collapsing distinct states.

invariants.name: Concurrent Conflict Recovery
invariants.implementation: onError handlers on useUpdateCaseStatus, useSignCase, and useResolveCase invalidate ['case', caseId] and ['cases'].

invariants.name: Regulatory Terminology
invariants.statement: Generated/exported regulatory artifacts must not be displayed as externally filed unless backend state establishes that.
invariants.implementation: Export FinCEN XML button is strictly disabled for closed_false_positive and unreviewed cases with clear explanatory tooltips.

invariants.name: Webhook Semantics
invariants.statement: At-least-once transport and failed test/delivery states must not be represented as exactly-once/success.
invariants.implementation: Webhook Security UI exposes delivery audit logs with explicit DELIVERED/FAILED badges and SSRF/DNS error diagnostics.
